newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends firmer vs dlr, steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends firmer vs dlr, steady vs basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed a shade firmer against the dollar but steady against the currency basket in Tuesday afternoon trade, dealers said.

The forint remained pinned to the resistance level of the central bank's (NBH) intervention band throughout the day and finished at 187.43/48, compared to 187.55/60 at the opening and 187.50/55 at midday.

"The dollar/mark was rangebound and although there were quite a lot of calls the market didn't move much as trade was two-way," said Attila Behan of ING Bank. "People are waiting for new developments."
Behan said he expected little change in the forint against the basket but said it would weaken against the dollar in the next few days as the U.S. unit is seen strengthening against the mark.
The forint floats in a 4.5 percent-wide central bank intervention band against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
